title: Filtering low-bookability map pins increased uncanceled bookings

change.control: Map results without filtering, capped at eighteen pins.
change.variant: Apply the Bookability Filter with alpha 1.0 to retain the most bookable pins.

result.metric: uncanceled bookings as share of overall global bookings

significance.reported: Key-metric p-values below 10^-5; exact values not published.

notes: Final large-scale confirmation, not another record for each earlier alpha trial. Five-star trips +2%; search-result impressions before discovery -16%, clicks -6.8%. Reported relative lift uses overall global bookings, not only triggered-map traffic.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
